closure.announced.export.description: Link in the notice of the server's closure to the page where the user asks for an archive of their data and downloads it.

closure.announced.export_until.defaultMessage: Après la fermeture, vous pourrez encore vous connecter et exporter vos données jusqu’au {date}.
closure.announced.export_until.description: Detail line of the notice of the server's closure: until when the user may sign in and export their data after the closure. {date} is a date in the user's locale and time zone.

closure.announced.headline.description: Headline of the notice kept at the top of every screen while the server's closure is announced. {instance} is the server's name; {date} is the closing date in the user's locale and time zone.

closure.announced.move.defaultMessage: Vous pouvez aussi déplacer votre compte vers un autre serveur avant la fermeture ; vos abonnés sur d’autres serveurs vous y suivront.
closure.announced.move.description: Detail line of the notice of the server's closure: the user can move their account to another server (an ActivityPub Move) before the closure.

closure.label.description: Accessible name of the region that holds the notice of the server's closure, in the list of landmarks.

closure.message_from.description: Label before the operators' own message in the notice of the server's closure and on the closed screen.

closure.closed.body.defaultMessage: {instance} a fermé le {date}. Tout le reste est désactivé. Vous pouvez encore vous connecter pour récupérer vos données jusqu’au {until}.
closure.closed.body.description: Text on the screen shown to a signed-in user after the server has closed. {instance} is the server's name; {date} is when it closed and {until} the end of the export period, both in the user's locale and time zone.

closure.closed.headline.description: Headline of the notice kept at the top of every screen, for a visitor who is not signed in, after the server has closed. {instance} is the server's name.

closure.closed.sign_in.defaultMessage: Connectez-vous pour exporter vos données jusqu’au {until}.
closure.closed.sign_in.description: Detail line of the notice for a visitor who is not signed in after the server has closed. {until} is the end of the export period in the user's locale and time zone.

closure.closed.sign_out.description: Button on the screen of a closed server that signs the user out.

closure.closed.title.description: Heading of the screen shown to a signed-in user after the server has closed; also the page name in the browser tab.

closure.closed.loading.defaultMessage: Chargement de vos exports de données
closure.closed.loading.description: Accessible name of the loading indicator on the screen of a closed server while the list of data exports loads.
